text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The intense battle of the Yayoi Sho draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the race over, Manhattan Cafe senses that Agnes Tachyon stands between her and her friend. She decides to pursue Agnes Tachyon instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an effort to run with Agnes Tachyon again, Manhattan Cafe shoots for the Satsuki Sho, a race in which Agnes Tachyon plans to compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Manhattan Cafe's poor condition is worrying. Having her compete in the Satsuki Sho or the Japanese Derby in her current state would be a gamble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I set the St. Lite Kinen as our autumn race and hold off making any decisions for the spring season. I'll have to see how Manhattan Cafe manages first.
